comparison_notes.2024_general: different: research UNDETERMINED, mine END (check 2). Same file and same facts: 'Precinct Results-11-5-2024' printed 'Run Time 7:39 PM 11/05/2024' with per-precinct Election Day votes, uploaded 2024-11-06 07:25 CT. The difference is interpretation: I accept a printed run time on election night as election-night evidence (as rule 43 does for LATER county-totals files, and as research itself does for Cass runoff and Hartley 2024, which were also uploaded the next day); research uses the next-morning upload as precinct_first_seen and so finds nothing from election night. Research facts are supported by the files.
